backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing products, orders, user profiles, and new service quote creation and admin-only quote retrieval and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping product requirements to affected frontend files and components with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of frontend file paths with short summaries describing each component's purpose and behavior.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide with pre-deployment checks, public access requirements, error handling, and build steps.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styling using OKLCH variables for light and dark themes and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file defining metadata, favicon, description, and mounting point for the React app.
frontend/public/404.html: SPA 404 fallback page that redirects unknown routes to index.html while preserving the intended path.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring router routes for public pages, products, checkout, quote requests, and admin sections.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary component that displays a fallback UI and offers reset and refresh actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with company info, navigation links, social icons, and a dynamic year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the main site header with logo, navigation links, cart indicator, and share button.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Wraps the page with a header, footer, and an outlet for routed content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Shows a product card with image, name, description, price, and link to product details.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: Provides a button that copies the current page URL to the clipboard with visual feedback.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/FaqSe: Renders an accordion-style FAQ section with predefined questions and answers.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Testi: Displays customer testimonials with ratings, names, locations, and review text.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Trust: Shows trust badges highlighting certifications, estimates, efficiency, and warranty.
frontend/src/constants/serviceAreaCopy.t: Exports a short string describing the service area.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on user identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLeads.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update service quotes via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminOrders.ts: Offers hooks to retrieve all orders and update order status through the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Contains hooks for CRUD operations on products using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminUsers.ts: Defines a hook to grant admin permissions to a user by email.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Provides a hook to fetch the caller's user role from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, loading identities, and exposing login state and actions.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaceOrder.ts: Wraps a place-order actor call in a React Query mutation and invalidates order queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Defines queries for fetching active products and individual product details using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceQuotes.ts: Creates a mutation for submitting service quote requests, refreshing quote data and showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind CSS layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables for UI styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query and Internet Identity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Provides authentication-gated admin layout, handling login, role checks, and navigation for admin sections.
Admin interface for viewing, sorting, and updating service quote leads, including status changes and admin notes.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrdersPage: Displays all orders with customer info and allows admins to update order status.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPa: Manages product list with create, edit, and archive actions using a dialog form.
Provides a form for granting admin permissions to users by email.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays and manages the shopping cart, including quantity adjustments, item removal, and cart totals.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Handles checkout form input, validation, order submission, and navigation to the confirmation page.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders the marketing homepage with hero content, trust signals, service highlights, and navigation actions.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows order confirmation details including the order ID and offers navigation back to product browsing.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Displays product details, handles quantity selection, and adds items to the cart with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/RequestQuotePage.tsx: Renders a service quote request form with validation and submits data, showing a confirmation on success.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Shows the storefront hero, trust signals, service highlights, and active products with navigation actions.
frontend/src/store/cart.ts: Zustand store managing cart items, quantity updates, removal, and total price calculation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, features, requests, and current development state.
